metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of zvoove Clean's portfolio for commercial cleaning and facility services: fortytools, KleanApp, CleanManager, Leviy, Nocore Clean and adata payroll, organised along Quote -> Specify -> Plan -> Clean -> Prove -> Pay -> Bill -> Steer.

bricks.name: Quote Calculation and Performance Figures
bricks.description: Calculates cleaning quotes from areas, room types, floor coverings, frequencies and performance figures (m² per hour), then prices hours with wage group, surcharges, materials and margin. The core of the quote workflow in fortytools and CleanManager cost calculation.

modules.name: Quote Builder
modules.description: Area-based calculation with performance figures and price scenarios.

modules.name: Price Engine
modules.description: Turns hours and frequencies into prices with wage costs from the tariff.

modules.name: Performance Figure Library
modules.description: Default and company-specific m²/h values per room type and covering.

brickDependencies.description: Quotes use the object's area register.

bricks.name: Cleaning Object and Service Specification Register
bricks.description: Master data of every cleaning object (site): buildings, floors, rooms, areas, access instructions, keys and the service specification (Leistungsverzeichnis) of what is cleaned how often. Used by planning, checklists, audits and billing.

modules.name: Object Editor
modules.description: Rooms, areas, floor plans and service specification per object.

modules.name: Object API
modules.description: Objects, rooms, areas, frequencies and access data.

modules.name: CAFM and Floor Plan Import
modules.description: Imports room books from CAFM systems and floor-plan files.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for service specifications.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Areas and room data from clients.

bricks.name: Client and Contract Management
bricks.description: Client accounts, contacts, contracts with term, price, indexation and notice periods, and the sales pipeline for tenders and renewals.

modules.name: Contract Workspace
modules.description: Clients, contracts, renewals and price adjustments.

modules.name: Contract API
modules.description: Clients, contracts, price agreements and renewal dates.

modules.name: Renewal and Indexation Monitor
modules.description: Flags notice deadlines and wage-driven price adjustments.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for clients and contracts.

bricks.name: Site Staffing and Recurring Schedule Planning
bricks.description: Plans who cleans which object when for recurring maintenance cleaning (Unterhaltsreinigung): target hours per object from the specification, staff assignments, part-time and minijob hour limits, and planned-versus-target hours.

modules.name: Schedule Board
modules.description: Objects by weekday with assigned staff and hour budgets.

modules.name: Schedule API
modules.description: Recurring assignments, hour budgets and plan versions.

modules.name: Plan Checker
modules.description: Checks hour budgets, minijob earnings limits and qualifications.

bricks.name: Mobile Team and Route Planning
bricks.description: Plans mobile teams for periodic and special cleaning (windows, floors, deep cleaning) across many objects with routes, vehicles and equipment.

modules.name: Route Planner
modules.description: Map-based team tours with time windows.

modules.name: Route Optimizer
modules.description: Sequences stops by time windows and travel time.

bricks.name: Absence and Same-Day Substitution
bricks.description: Records sickness and leave, finds qualified substitutes who know the object and are within their hour limits, and notifies them in their language - the daily fire-fight of every cleaning operation.

modules.name: Absence Console
modules.description: Today's absences, uncovered objects and suggested substitutes.

modules.name: Substitute Notifier
modules.description: Offers uncovered shifts to candidates via the app.

modules.name: Substitute Ranker
modules.description: Ranks by object knowledge, distance, hours left and language.

bricks.name: Work Orders and Special Cleaning Jobs
bricks.description: One-off and periodic work orders beyond the recurring plan - window cleaning, carpet cleaning, construction final cleaning, event cleaning - with scope, materials and sign-off.

modules.name: Work Order Board
modules.description: Open, scheduled and completed work orders.

modules.name: Work Order API
modules.description: Work orders, scope, assignment and sign-off.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for work orders.

rootGroups.name: Field Execution and Quality
rootGroups.description: Doing the work and proving it.

bricks.name: Cleaner Mobile App
bricks.description: Multilingual app for cleaning staff: today's objects, tasks and checklists, clock-in, substitution offers, messages, payslips and leave requests - built for low-literacy, multilingual and part-time staff.

modules.name: Cleaner App
modules.description: Pictogram-led, multilingual app with offline mode.

modules.name: Cleaner App BFF
modules.description: Aggregates tasks, clock-in, messages and payslips for the app.

modules.name: Message Translation Worker
modules.description: Translates instructions and messages into the cleaner's language.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Apple App Store and Google Play

bricks.name: Time and Attendance Proof
bricks.description: Proves presence at the object: NFC tags, QR/barcodes, terminals, GPS and geofence clock-in (KleanApp, Crewmeister-style), with planned-versus-actual comparison feeding payroll and client proof.

modules.name: Attendance Monitor
modules.description: Live presence per object and missing clock-ins.

modules.name: No-Show Detector
modules.description: Alerts when nobody clocked in at a scheduled object.

modules.name: Terminal and NFC Connector
modules.description: Reads NFC tags, barcodes and terminal punches.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for worked hours.

bricks.name: Digital Checklists and Service Proof
bricks.description: Room-by-room checklists derived from the service specification, completed on the phone with photos and signatures, producing proof of service for the client.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for service proof.

bricks.name: Sensor-Based and Demand-Driven Cleaning
bricks.description: Connects occupancy, footfall and dispenser sensors so cleaning is triggered by use rather than fixed frequency (Leviy sensor integration).

modules.name: Sensor Dashboard
modules.description: Levels, occupancy and triggered tasks per object.

modules.name: Demand Trigger Engine
modules.description: Creates tasks when thresholds are reached.

modules.name: IoT Connector
modules.description: Dispenser, people-counter and occupancy sensor platforms.

bricks.name: Quality Audits and Inspections
bricks.description: Digital quality inspections by supervisors and clients using standard methods (DIN EN 13549 in DACH, VSR/NEN 2075 in the Netherlands), with scores, photos and corrective actions. The heart of KleanApp, Leviy and CleanManager quality control.

modules.name: Audit Reports
modules.description: Scores by object, area and trend.

modules.name: Audit API
modules.description: Audit plans, samples, scores and corrective actions.

modules.name: Sampling and Scoring Engine
modules.description: Draws samples and scores per standard.

bricks.name: Client Requests and Defect Tickets
bricks.description: Clients, building users and supervisors report issues (QR code in the room, portal, app); tickets route to the object team with SLAs and photo proof of resolution.

modules.name: QR Issue Report
modules.description: Building users scan a QR code and report an issue without login.

bricks.name: Client Portal and Service Reports
bricks.description: Gives facility managers transparency: service proof, attendance, audit scores, tickets and invoices per object, plus monthly service reports.

modules.name: Client Portal BFF
modules.description: Aggregates proof, audits, tickets and invoices.

bricks.name: Staff Administration and Onboarding
bricks.description: Employee records for a large, part-time and multilingual workforce: contracts, minijob status, work permits, documents, qualifications and digital onboarding.

modules.name: Digital Onboarding Form
modules.description: New staff enter personal, tax and bank data on the phone.

modules.name: Permit Expiry Monitor
modules.description: Warns before permits and contracts expire.

bricks.name: Cleaning Payroll Engine
bricks.description: Payroll for the building-cleaning trade: generally binding collective agreement wage groups, surcharges, minijob and midijob rules, Sofortmeldung, many short part-time contracts and hours from attendance. adata's facility-management payroll and Nocore Clean payroll in the Netherlands.

modules.name: Tariff API
modules.description: Wage groups, surcharges and earnings limits by effective date.

modules.name: Gross-to-Net Service
modules.description: Tax and social-security calculation incl. minijob rules.

bricks.name: Managed Payroll Service Desk
bricks.description: Tooling for zvoove Clean's managed payroll service (announced with the adata acquisition): case queues, SLAs, four-eyes release and delegated access.

modules.name: Service Desk
modules.description: Customer payroll cases and cut-off SLAs.

bricks.name: Recurring and Extra-Service Invoicing
bricks.description: Monthly flat-fee invoices from contracts, plus extra services and work orders, price indexation after wage increases, e-invoicing and receivables.

modules.name: Invoice Console
modules.description: Invoice runs, extras and credit notes.

modules.name: Invoice API
modules.description: Invoices, extras, credit notes and status.

modules.name: Invoice Run
modules.description: Monthly recurring run and extras on completion.

bricks.name: Accounting Export and Statutory Reporting
bricks.description: DATEV and ledger exports, social-security and tax reporting, and SOKA/contribution filings triggered by payroll and invoicing.

modules.name: Export Runner
modules.description: Builds exports and filings after runs.

bricks.name: Object Profitability and Operations Analytics
bricks.description: Compares calculated, planned and actual hours per object, computes contribution margin per object and contract, and tracks sickness, turnover and quality trends.

modules.name: Object Profitability Dashboard
modules.description: Margin, hour deviation and quality per object.

modules.name: ELT Pipeline
modules.description: Loads operational data into the warehouse.

bricks.name: AI Operations Assistant
bricks.description: Shared AI layer for the cleaning brands: translation for multilingual staff, quote drafts from floor plans and specifications, plan suggestions and natural-language questions about objects - behind one guarded gateway.

modules.name: Assistant Panel
modules.description: Ask about objects, hours and margins; draft quotes.

modules.name: LLM Gateway
modules.description: Guarded model access with PII redaction and logging.

modules.name: Assistant Orchestrator
modules.description: Routes questions to analytics and tools.

bricks.name: Integration Hub
bricks.description: Public API, event bus and bridges between cleaning brands (fortytools, KleanApp, CleanManager, Leviy, Nocore, adata) and to zvoove staffing products when cleaning companies also lease workers.

modules.name: Event Bus
modules.description: Attendance, audit, payroll and invoice events.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Customer ERP, CAFM and HR systems

bricks.name: Tenant, Identity and Country Packs
bricks.description: Tenants, roles, delegated access and country packs (DE, AT, CH, NL, DK, UK, ES) that switch language, tariffs, filings and audit standards.
